coaching.headline: We kept winning bodies and giving the map — fight after fight we traded kills for their Fangtooth/Mini Prime while our ahead carry sat in lane. Objectives 15-34, towers 3-11.
coaching.team: This wasn't a lane problem — GRIM.exe (11/4/8, ours all game) and Murdock (9/6/5, even early and ours late) won the bot side. It was a map problem, and the same one every fight: we won the kills but they took the objective across the map — at 13.8 and 14.5 they traded for Mini Prime and at 18.2 for Fangtooth, flagged plainly as won bodies, gave the objective. Worse, we opened up a man at 27.9 (2-2), 30.2 (0-3) and 35.2 (1-4) and didn't win them, and our ahead carry GRIM was repeatedly alive-and-winning-lane but not in the fight. Two fixes: when we're even or up on bodies, fight ON the objective so the kills actually buy Prime/Fangtooth — and get the won lanes to group before forcing the next one.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: We out-killed them in skirmish after skirmish but let them trade every won fight for a major across the map — they out-took neutrals and out-towered us 11-3. Stop fighting away from the prize: group as five and take Fangtooth/Prime WITH the kills, and don't open a 5v4 while our ahead carry is still farming.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Murdock offlane, 9/6/5 — Mr_Meat31 won the lane late exactly as read (even early, ours late), and three of the six deaths came before the Vanquisher spike (~25m). The bigger note is rotation: at 30.2 and 38.1 the macro had Mr_Meat31 alive and ahead in lane while the team fought without him — shove the wave and join the objective fight, because a body up there flips those losses.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: GRIM.exe carry, 11/4/8 and the lane read Goldilocks324's way all game vs Sparrow — Goldilocks324's best game, but read the macro flags: at 35m and 39m Goldilocks324 was alive and ahead in lane and NOT at the fight — the 35.2 fight went 1-4 even with a 5v4, and the 39.2 one opened 4v5. When the lane is that far ahead, shove and rotate — the kills mean nothing farming a side lane while the team drops those fights.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Zinx mid into Renna was theirs at every checkpoint and Cuban Noobster only came online around the Oathkeeper spike ~19m — pinned and losing, Zinx couldn't help the objective fights, which is fine. The fix is to stop taking the 1v1 before 19m: farm safe and don't be the body that's dead or absent. Cuban Noobster also ran no armor into a 3-physical comp (their Sparrow hit 34k), so Zinx folds fast — buy it next time.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Phase support, 0/6/20 — 20 assists and 33378 mitigated is real frontline work. The lane read theirs all game, and Willy Guggenheim was often the pinned, losing body who couldn't rotate, so several of those away-from-objective fights shouldn't have dragged Phase in. Ward the enemy jungle so the team sees the cross-map Fangtooth/Prime coming and groups for it instead of trading into it.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Yin jungle, 6/11/6 with eleven deaths — Xeebs was in nearly every losing skirmish, and a lot of them were fights taken away from the objective or a body short. Full-clear to catch up and stop being the tip of a 5v4 that isn't on top of a prize. Like Zinx, Xeebs skipped armor into a 3-physical comp — that's a big chunk of the deaths.

grim-exe.loadout: Xyris (Furor + Cull the Weak), augment System Restore, crest Liberator
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,236 hero damage a minute, more than 80% of GRIM.exe carry players this patch (30% of the team's). The damage came from Lightning Hawk, Imperator, Sky Splitter.
GRIM.exe dealt 49,453 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +232 physical power from items.
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.
Cull the Weak (Eternal minor): Deal 7% bonus damage to Minions and Monsters, and restore 1% Missing Mana on unit kill.
Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; 3,018 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Plasma Blade, Dust Devil, Sky Splitter.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Liberator.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players GRIM.exe killed built physical armor (Feng Mao, Lt. Belica). Anti-heal on Renna, Lt. Belica, Feng Mao. We killed GRIM.exe 4 times.

Copy it? Xyris: 54.4% in 296 GRIM.exe carry games, above the hero's 47.2%; this 3-item core: 53.2% in 62 games, below the 56.5% of that hero-role's cores. Mixed: copy the part that wins, not the whole setup.
